title: Smoked Mackerel Salad with Garlic Aïoli
description: Smoked mackerel served over bulgur wheat and quinoa with broccoli and asparagus, finished with a garlicky yogurt aïoli.
ingredients: For the aïoli: 4 garlic cloves crushed, 1 egg + 1 egg white, 200g fat-free Greek yogurt, juice of 1 lemon, salt
250g asparagus spears, trimmed and cut into 2cm pieces
steps: Make aïoli: whisk garlic, egg and egg white together; stir in yogurt and lemon juice; season with salt.
Cook bulgur wheat and quinoa per package instructions; combine and cool.
Steam or simmer broccoli and asparagus for 3–4 minutes until just tender; drain.
Divide grains between plates; top with broccoli, asparagus, spring onions and mackerel.
Drizzle aïoli over and finish with black pepper.
notes: The aïoli also works as a dip for Baked Sweet Potato Wedges (p.150).
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
